Thank you for having Tom and me out at the Island this week. I know your schedule is extremely busy, and I
   really appreciate the amount of time you were able to spend with us. The work sessions were productive, and
   I think we have a clear approach to the new conceptual layout.

   area, living room/cabana, and primary circulation paths. I will include notes about each of the various areas
   we discussed. Gary and I arc also working on a master schedule for design and construction of each of these
   areas.



For clarity and efficiency, and to make sure we prioritize your needs, I think we need to separate major areas into
    the following:

I. Main Residence. This is the primary focus. This includes the pool area, the living room, the north terrace.
   and the stairs connecting the master bedroom, terrace, living room area, and east upper garden area.

2. Guest cottage. New guest cottage with 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a sitting room, patio and access stair.

3. Spa. 4 treatment rooms, sitting area, bathroom/support spaces. With exterior sitting area near top ofnursery.
   and hardscape treatment at bottom ofnursery (over existing concrete pad).

4. Music room.

5. Staff cottage. 4 bedrooms with private baths, living/dining/kitchen area, laundry and support.



I am also contacting our A/V consultant for recommendations on appropriately-scaled equipment for your living
   room/media room.
